summary: Matches two packed name strings from an input packet against stored cloud-scene name buffers on the object; when the names differ it copies both names into the object buffers, then either triggers cloud texture setup (sub_4FC550) or stores a session-type code at this+0x44. When the names already match it refreshes the stored type code unless it is -1. Execution is gated by a multiplayer flag bit and a scoring-gate packed-flag read.

operations.description: Match/update path runs only when bit0 of dword_7C56A0 is clear OR the scoring-gate condition holds (dword_8AB6E4 equals 2 and PackedFlagRead_9a00 of dword_8AB6EC returns 0).
Compute input string pointers from packet a2: first name at a2+8, second name starting right after its NUL, and extract the type code v12 = byte(a2+3) & 7.

Names differ when strcmp of the stored first-name buffer (this+0x50) with the input first name is non-zero OR strcmp of the stored second-name buffer (this+0x84) with the input second name is non-zero.
Copy 31 bytes of the input first name into the first buffer (this+0x50) via sub_587DD0 and write the NUL terminator at this+0x6F.
Copy 31 bytes of the input second name into the second buffer (this+0x84) via sub_587DD0 and write the NUL terminator at this+0xA3.

After updating names: when the scoring-gate flag v10 is set or the extracted type code equals dword_7C56A4 (session type), call sub_4FC550 to load cloud textures; otherwise store the extracted type code into this+0x44.
When names already match and the stored type code at this+0x44 is not -1 (guard), refresh it with the extracted type code.
Return the last computed status value (effectively void semantics).

unresolved: Exact meaning of bit0 of dword_7C56A0 (multiplayer flag) and of the packed flag read via dword_8AB6EC is not established.
Semantics of the extracted type code (byte(a2+3) & 7) and its relation to dword_7C56A4 are unknown.
sub_4FC550 confirmed as cloud-texture setup only from existing analysis, not from this function alone.
